nodes.rationale: Prioritizes demo stability, clarity, and readiness for a school project demonstration over production-scale infrastructure or Next.js/Supabase migration.

nodes.norm_label: utc streak & reset rules (1-day grace period)

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Progression & Terminal Approvals
nodes.rationale: Computes XP, levels, EcoPoints, UTC streaks, and achievements atomically on the server and makes approved submissions terminal (409 Conflict) to prevent client forgery or double-granting.

nodes.label: Privacy-First Evidence Policy
nodes.rationale: Avoids selfies, facial recognition, or IDs, stores evidence privately, and lets users delete stored photos anytime without losing earned XP or EcoPoints.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers AI (@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it)
nodes.rationale: Uses max_tokens: 2048 because Gemma 4 emits reasoning_content thinking tokens before content; keeps a single free-tier provider without OpenRouter or multi-provider routing.

nodes.label: Non-Transactional MVP ShopView
nodes.rationale: Displays EcoPoints balance and reward previews only; live spending and fulfillment are deferred out of MVP scope.

nodes.label: Zero Paid Services ($0 Budget)
nodes.rationale: Enforces a strict $0 free-tier budget with no paid AI APIs, SaaS tools, subscriptions, or paid dependencies.

nodes.label: Admin Moderation Loop (Review Queue & Quest Manager)
nodes.norm_label: admin moderation loop (review queue & quest manager)

nodes.label: Graceful AI Fallback (needs_review)
nodes.rationale: AI is an assistant, never a blocker: missing credentials, 25s timeouts, quota limits, or invalid JSON fall back to needs_review so users can always submit quests for manual admin review.

nodes.label: Conservative Verification Over False Certainty
nodes.rationale: Refuses to auto-approve unverifiable off-camera quantities or durations from a single photo and routes ambiguity to needs_review for human moderation.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md — EcoQuest Contributor & AI Agent Guide
nodes.norm_label: agents.md — ecoquest contributor & ai agent guide

nodes.label: DESIGN.md — The Field Journal Design System
nodes.norm_label: design.md — the field journal design system
nodes.rationale: Treats real-world eco-actions like calm, evidence-led field journal entries rather than loud gamification or glossy gradients.

nodes.label: Technical Identifiers (EN) vs. User-Facing Copy (HU)
nodes.rationale: Keeps slugs, achievement codes, enum keys, DB columns, API routes, and AI schema keys in English for code stability while presenting all UI copy and AI summaries in natural Hungarian.

nodes.label: The Rare Lime Rule
nodes.rationale: Reserves Canopy Lime strictly for primary CTAs, active navigation/tab states, and key progress markers to preserve visual restraint and contrast.

nodes.label: The Semantic Clarity Rule (StatusIndicator)
nodes.rationale: Pairs every verification status with a distinct Lucide icon, explicit text label, and semantic tint so accessibility never depends on color alone.

nodes.label: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
nodes.rationale: Applies JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums to XP, EcoPoints, UTC streak days, and AI confidence percentages so numbers align cleanly and never jitter on updates.

nodes.label: The Zero-Shadow Rule
nodes.rationale: Eliminates box-shadow elevation and communicates depth exclusively through tonal surface stepping and 1px hairline borders so photo evidence and verification criteria stay scannable.
